echo "=== $(date -u) ===" && for i in 0 1 2 3; do echo -n "shard_$i: "; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/root/autodl-tmp/rsft_generations/shard_$i/progress.json')); print(f\"{d.get('completed',0)}/{d.get('total',0)} ({100*d.get('completed',0)/max(d.get('total',1),1):.1f}%)\")" 2>/dev/null || echo "error"; done && echo "=== GPU ===" && nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv,noheader 2>/dev/null | head -8
